CV.subject: CV
CV.summary: I design and build products end to end. For {years}+ years I owned the frontend of Kabila, a Web3 startup in Madrid, taking a social platform, NFT marketplace, creator tools and native and browser wallets from rough ideas to polished products. I work across design and engineering: maintaining design systems, shaping product flows and building the frontend architecture behind them. My focus is turning complex blockchain interactions into simple, intuitive experiences for users who may be new to crypto. I'm most effective in high-autonomy environments where I can move quickly, make product decisions and own outcomes.
CV.headline: Product Engineer - Next.js Expert

kabila.name: Product Engineer
descriptions: Owned Kabila's Web3 frontend end to end across its social platform, NFT marketplace, creator tools and wallets
Designed interfaces in Figma and built the shared design system and component library used across the product suite
Designed and shipped guided flows that turn complex on-chain operations into simple steps for non-crypto users
Led frontend architecture, technical and sprint planning, taking features from idea to production in fast iterations
Built and shipped the native wallet with React Native and Expo to the App Store and Google Play
Worked directly with product and design stakeholders to define scope, make trade-offs and decide what to build

archeMC2.name: DevOps Engineer Apprentice
descriptions: Built GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
Containerized internal applications and services with Docker
Automated infrastructure tasks and monitoring with shell scripts

efficienceInformatique.name: System Administrator Intern
descriptions: Administered Windows servers and Hyper-V virtualization across the internal infrastructure
Implemented and maintained backup strategies for critical business data
Supported ERP systems (SAP and Sage) used by finance and operations teams

iutSecurity.name: Bachelor's Degree, System Administration and Security

bravalta.name: Bravalta
bravalta.description: Company website for Bravalta, an enterprise DLT and AI consultancy.
highlights: Delivered fast page loads and strong SEO by choosing Astro static rendering over a client-heavy stack
Owned UI/UX from concept to production, designing and building every user flow
Created the site's motion design and animations

kabilaApp.name: Kabila App
kabilaApp.description: Kabila's flagship Web3 platform: social network, NFT marketplace, community plazas, launchpads and token staking.
highlights: Consolidated 3 separate apps into one flagship product, leading the migration end to end
$500K+ in trading volume across 100K+ sales on the NFT marketplace I built and maintained
Cut duplicated code across the 3 apps with a shared internal SDK for all blockchain interactions
Kept 3 products visually consistent with a design system and component library I designed and built

kabilaWalletNative.name: Kabila Wallet (Native)
kabilaWalletNative.description: Kabila's mobile wallet for iOS and Android: accounts, tokens, NFTs and dApp connections on the go.
highlights: Took the mobile wallet from zero to 10K+ users, built with React Native and Expo
Shipped and maintained production releases on iOS and Android: builds, store reviews and updates
Designed and implemented the wallet UI/UX, making accounts, tokens and signing clear to non-crypto users
Brought the main app's design language to native, so users get one consistent Kabila experience

kabilaTools.name: Kabila Tools
kabilaTools.description: Self-serve NFT toolkit that lets creators and communities create, launch and manage collections.
highlights: Owned the frontend of the creator suite serving 5K+ users
Shipped 20+ creator tools on one platform, covering the full NFT collection lifecycle
Made on-chain launches self-serve: creators ship NFT collections through guided flows, no code needed
Built responsive UI/UX for complex multi-step flows that stay usable on any screen size

kabilaWallet.name: Kabila Wallet (Extension)
kabilaWallet.description: Kabila's non-custodial browser-extension wallet, with a mobile build from the same codebase.
highlights: Shipped a non-custodial Chrome extension wallet adopted by 2K+ users
Made security the core requirement: keys stay on-device and every sensitive action needs explicit consent
Covered desktop and mobile as a single engineer by reusing one React codebase through Capacitor
Designed connection and approval flows so users always see exactly what they sign

ferreiraBorges.name: Ferreira Borges Thomas
ferreiraBorges.description: Website for a local car repair business.
highlights: Delivered a freelance site end to end, from client discovery and design to build and launch
Built a conversion-first page with transparent pricing, click-to-call and quote requests
Optimized local SEO so the garage ranks in nearby searches

acVision.name: AC-Vision
acVision.description: Real-time supervision dashboard for DASAN fiber network equipment (OLTs and ONUs).
highlights: Gave network operators live visibility into DASAN fiber equipment through a real-time dashboard
Wrote the Python API polling devices over SNMP, with a Redis cache to limit load on network gear
Containerized the stack with Docker and automated image builds in GitHub Actions

brianGravure.name: Brian Grav&Style
brianGravure.description: Custom online store and order management for a professional engraving studio.
highlights: Gave the owner an admin dashboard to run stock, orders and daily operations without a developer
Designed and built the custom store end to end as a freelance project
Integrated Stripe for secure checkout and payments

portfolioV1.name: Portfolio V1
portfolioV1.description: My previous portfolio, since replaced by this interactive terminal.
highlights: Built every animation from scratch with Framer Motion for a smooth, polished feel
Surfaced my curated bookmarks on the site through the Raindrop.io API
Added an MDX blog to publish technical writing alongside the portfolio

tsNextKit.name: ts-next-chakra-motion-kit
tsNextKit.description: Open-source Next.js starter kit with Chakra UI, Framer Motion and TypeScript.
highlights: Open-source starter that takes a Next.js site from zero to production-ready
Ships theming, reusable animated components, i18n, SEO and sitemap generation out of the box
Documented setup, structure and conventions so other developers can adopt it quickly

rtransport.name: RT'ransport
rtransport.description: A parcel delivery platform built for my first-year project in DUT Networks & Telecoms (two-year university degree).
highlights: Architected two Flask services: a versioned REST API and a server-rendered Tailwind client on top
Modeled the parcel logistics domain in SQLAlchemy on PostgreSQL: parcels, relay points and hubs
Built hop-by-hop parcel tracking, with dedicated views for customers, suppliers and operators
